top.line: PrompTugal.news goes local: Portugal, the Algarve and every Algarve town, each on its own subdomain.
top.para: Each site a lens on one shared graph; every story must connect to AI.

in-short.line: Local, one set of agents, subdomains, lenses, the test, and the first wave.

why.line: My answer to Vicky Wang's plan: option A, with a subdomain per place from the start.
why.para: Because there will be many, made automatically.

north-star.line: The brand, the PrompTugal test, place against AI, and a mandate per site.
north-star.para: Four rules so it does not escalate.

levels.line: Portugal, the Algarve, the towns; news flows down and local sources rise up.

lens.line: One graph of stories, places, companies and events, read from each site's centre.
lens.para: A story is written once and listed by every site it concerns.

town.line: Mandate, centre of gravity, local AI news, wider news, events, companies, extras, gaps.
town.para: Each town looks like itself, with a playful local voice.

wave.line: Every Algarve town at once, with the Algarve site above them.
wave.para: Research per town: centre, stories, sources, events, companies, gaps.

built.line: One repository and one build; a place is one entry in a list.
built.para: Subdomains, never paths; DNS when ready.

limits.line: Nothing built yet; what is not now; an earlier version with paths first.

sources.line: My brief of 14 November, Vicky's plan and the earlier version.
